content.title: THE MINERAL BEHIND YOUR {{ENERGY CRASH}}
facts: **Iron** (Oxygen Carrier) — Beef Liver | Lentil Soup | Pumpkin Seeds | Dark Leafy Greens — low levels leave your cells gasping for oxygen, which is why you feel wiped out by 2pm.
**Magnesium** (Nervous System Dimmer) — Almonds | Black Beans | Swiss Chard | Dark Chocolate — quiets an overactive nervous system so your body can actually downshift at night.
**Calcium** (Signal Sender) — Sardines | Bok Choy | Tahini | White Beans — your muscles can't contract and your nerves can't fire a single signal without it.
**Zinc** (Wound Healer) — Oysters | Chickpeas | Cashews | Eggs — cuts and scrapes close noticeably slower when your levels run low.
**Phosphorus** (Energy Currency) — Salmon | Lentils | Pumpkin Seeds | Yogurt — teams up with your cells to literally build the molecule your body burns for energy.

**Chromium** (Blood Sugar Helper) — Broccoli | Grape Juice | Whole Wheat Bread | Green Beans — helps insulin do its job so sugar actually gets pulled into your cells instead of lingering in your blood.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Let's talk about a few of these in more depth. Iron is the one most people underestimate — without enough of it, your red blood cells can't hold onto oxygen properly, so even a full night's sleep won't stop that mid-afternoon crash. Magnesium works almost like a dimmer switch on your nervous system, calming nerve signals down so your body can actually shift into rest mode instead of staying wired. And phosphorus rarely gets mentioned, but it partners directly with your cells to build the energy molecule (ATP) your whole body runs on — no phosphorus, no fuel. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and get levels checked before assuming a deficiency.
